attributes.name: Blackjacket
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to reduce all damage dealt to you by 2.

Recharge this card to ignore a bane's power that happens after you act.

Banish this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you to 0.

If proficient with light armors, recharge this card to add 1d4 to your Stealth check.
